messages:
Sam Holt: Hey team — need a single-page solution brief + micro-landing for enterprise buyers focused on security, SLA guarantees, and deployment modes. Core asks: one tight paragraph value prop, three pillar bullets (security, reliability, deployment), a procurement checklist, inbound lead-routing rules, and a benchmark callout. Also plan a supporting webinar and an A/B CTA test. Thoughts?

Rina Shah: Suggest headline: 'Enterprise-grade LLM inference that meets your security and procurement needs.' Then 3 short sections with 3 bullets each. Add a small boxed benchmark: cost delta vs self-host and p99 number.

Omar Velasquez: Routing rules: add lead form fields: deployment_preference, compliance_level, expected_monthly_tokens, procurement_timeline. Rule set: if compliance_level==high OR procurement_timeline<=30 days OR expected_monthly_tokens>5e6 => route to AE. If deployment_preference==Private => route to SolutionsEng + Security. Example JSON for form: `{"deployment_preference":"Hosted|Dedicated|Private","compliance_level":"low|medium|high","expected_monthly_tokens":number,"procurement_timeline_days":number}`

Tess Green: Procurement checklist to include in brief: required docs (DPA, business justification, network architecture), expected contracting timeline (30-60 days for Dedicated, 14-30 for Hosted), sample SLA terms (uploader: uptime % and exclusions), and contact points (AE, Solutions Eng, Security). Keep concise bullet list.

LegalBot: Language check: use qualifiers. Recommend: "supports customer-managed KMS and audit logs, VPC/private control plane options, and configurable data retention." For SLA copy: "SLA-backed uptime subject to standard exclusions (scheduled maintenance, force majeure)." Avoid claiming certifications unless validated.

Rina Shah: Benchmark narrative idea: highlight a real pattern — embeddings + reranking pipeline. Use conservative verified callout: "Internal Redwood lab: Dedicated with KV caching + int8 quantization delivered ~22% lower unit cost at steady-state throughput; p99 generation latency ~95ms on our benchmark model. Internal results; customer workloads may vary."

Omar Velasquez: For the one-pager layout: left column = quick value prop + CTA, middle column = 3 pillars with micro-bullets, right column = procurement checklist + benchmark box. Include a tiny decision matrix: which deployment to pick (Hosted = fast onboarding, Dedicated = predictable throughput, Private = air-gapped/regulatory).

Tess Green: Webinar plan: 45-min workshop (25-min demo + 15-min technical deep dive + 5-min live QA). Tentative date: Nov 30. Prep items: registration page, partner co-promo, targeted email to mid-enterprise accounts, slide deck with architecture and procurement playbook.

Rina Shah: CTA A/B test ideas: A) "Request enterprise trial" B) "Schedule a secure review". Route A -> immediate self-serve trial flow with optional AE outreach; route B -> direct AE booking. We'll track MQL->SQL conversion.

Sam Holt: Great. Action owners: @Omar build lead form + routing JSON, @Tess draft procurement checklist and SLA blurb, @Rina assemble one-pager copy and design comps, @LegalBot finalize legal phrasings, @CampaignBot prepare webinar ops. I'll compile and send draft to execs by EOD Friday.

CampaignBot: Noted. I'll add webinar to calendar, create RSVP page draft, and queue targeted email to trial users.
